nodes.label: Project Definition - Manuscript Deliverable
nodes.rationale: Deliverable is a manuscript, not a model; no production inference path, no export bundle.

nodes.label: Working Title (D60a, 2026-08-20)
nodes.rationale: Repositioned to a descriptive, non-comparative title after the Stage 5 gate failed.

nodes.label: Superseded Title
nodes.rationale: Old comparative title assumed added variates buy accuracy; every rung's R2_oos is negative so the question has no numerator.

nodes.label: Target Venue: Indonesian Sinta Journal
nodes.rationale: IMRaD, 10-14 pages, IEEE style; scope fixed to spot-only single-asset BTCUSDT.

nodes.label: Hard Constraints Table (Section 2)
nodes.rationale: Non-negotiable never/instead rules: PyTorch-only, polars data plane, no imputation, no winsorizing, no centred rolling windows.

nodes.label: Polars-Only Data Plane, Two Named pandas Exceptions
nodes.rationale: polars' rolling API is backward-closed so the center=True leak class is unrepresentable; pandas allowed only at Stage 1 ingest and one stats boundary.

nodes.label: RQ1 - Nominal K vs Effective Dimensionality K_eff
nodes.rationale: H1: benefit tracks K_eff. Measured: K explanation rejected, K_eff explanation not rejected - but on a ladder where every rung has negative skill.

nodes.label: RQ2 - Does the Multivariate Gap Narrow With Model Age
nodes.rationale: H2: gap narrows, beta1<0. Measured beta1=+0.000256, wrong sign and inside the MDE - reported as descriptive.

nodes.label: RQ3 - Optimal Retraining Cadence
nodes.rationale: H3: larger K decays faster. Measured b* UNDEFINED at all origins - estimand undefined, not censored, not rejected.

nodes.label: Pre-Registered Thresholds (tau, equivalence margin, answer space)
nodes.rationale: Fixed in advance; choosing any threshold after seeing the curve is p-hacking.

nodes.label: Economic Mechanism Behind H2
nodes.rationale: Shifting participant composition (retail to leverage cycle to institutional/ETF flow) grounded in the Adaptive Markets Hypothesis.

nodes.label: Claimed Contributions (hedged)
nodes.rationale: First walk-forward iTransformer-on-crypto decay study; hedged as 'to the best of our knowledge'.

nodes.label: Data Contract Section 4 - Measured Facts
nodes.rationale: Measured from data/raw/BTCUSDT_1h_report.json, not assumed; re-verify after any refresh.

nodes.label: Artifact Vintage / sha256 Pinning
nodes.rationale: Numbers produced under different hashes are not comparable and must not share a table.

nodes.label: Gaps Are Not Missing Values (Section 4.2)
nodes.rationale: Exchange downtime forms no price at all, so Rubin's MCAR/MAR/MNAR taxonomy does not apply.

nodes.label: No-Imputation Defence
nodes.rationale: ffill fabricates a zero return and poisons F2 volatility estimators at exactly the outage boundary.

nodes.label: Segment Law (Section 4.3)
nodes.rationale: A segment is a maximal run of contiguous usable bars, broken by gaps and by zero-volume/H==L bars.

nodes.label: Windows Validated by Timestamp, Never Positional Index
nodes.rationale: Highest-probability silent bug: after any row drop, positional sliding closes gaps invisibly.

nodes.label: The Artifact on Disk (Section 4.4)
nodes.rationale: D10 and D11 are closed - neither defect ever existed on the parquet artifact; the register was stale.

nodes.label: Preliminary Market-Efficiency Tests (Section 4.5)
nodes.rationale: Variance Ratio, Hurst, ADF reported full-sample and per-origin sub-block; efficiency not claimed, only evidence reported.

nodes.label: F1 Price Trajectory (r, upper_shadow, lower_shadow)
F2 Volatility Estimators (Parkinson, Garman-Klass, Rogers-Satchell)
nodes.rationale: Per-bar, no trailing average; Rogers-Satchell uses log(RS+1e-9) since it vanishes on shadowless marubozu bars.

nodes.label: F3 Intensity (log_quote_volume, log_trade_count, log_mean_trade_size)
F4 Order Flow (taker_buy_ratio, signed_flow)
nodes.rationale: signed_flow is a deterministic product of two other K=8 members, disclosed as weakening the max-effective-rank claim.

nodes.label: F5 Intrabar Location (vwap_location)
The K Ladder - K=1,4,8,12 (Section 5.2)
nodes.rationale: Source specification's K=8 rung summed to nine and double-assigned a variate; exactly one consistent cut exists.

nodes.label: 8-to-12 Rung as Deliberate Redundancy Control
nodes.rationale: Adds four nominal variates with almost no additional rank; measured K=12 PR is below K=8's, stronger evidence than designed.

nodes.label: No Variate May Be Added Outside F1-F5
nodes.rationale: A convenience variate breaks the taxonomy and makes the K=8 vs K=12 contrast uninterpretable.

nodes.label: Feature-Engineering Policy - Why Exactly Twelve (Section 5.3)
nodes.rationale: Excludes RSI/MACD/Bollinger, multi-bar rolling stats, calendar dummies, cross-asset/on-chain/macro data; K is RQ1's independent variable.

nodes.label: Sample Budget: 13,558-15,217 Training Windows
nodes.rationale: Against 12x96=1,152 input dims, on the 21-month sub-block per origin, not the 24-month 17,400 count.

nodes.label: Benchmark Positioning vs iTransformer's Own Suite
nodes.rationale: K<=12 sits deliberately in the few-features-one-entity regime (ETTh1=7) vs many-entities (Traffic=862).

nodes.label: Optional K=16 Rung - NOT RUN
nodes.rationale: Run condition clause 1 (Stage 5 gate pass) failed; running it anyway would be exactly the post-hoc rung Section 5.3 forbids.

nodes.label: Pre-Model K_eff Measurement (Section 5.4)
nodes.rationale: Run before training anything; produces RQ1's independent variable and tests H2's premise at zero extra data cost.

nodes.label: Participation Ratio PR
nodes.rationale: PR=(sum lambda)^2/sum(lambda^2) on the correlation matrix, per-origin training-only span; RQ1's varying regressor.

nodes.label: Lookback-Aware PR (K.L x K.L spectrum)
nodes.rationale: Contemporaneous PR is blind to cross-lag structure; reported on the correlation, not covariance, spectrum.

nodes.label: Stable Rank K/lambda1
nodes.rationale: Within-window correlation matrix stable rank captures cross-variate structure inside a window.

nodes.label: Gate PR - Pre-First-Origin Span
nodes.rationale: Gates the ladder only; pre-registered trigger PR<5.0 disclose. Measured 4.393 - the gate did not pass.

nodes.label: Rolling PR / Rolling OLS R2 - Descriptive Only
nodes.rationale: Full-sample, may inform no design decision; establishes H2's premise before any model runs.

nodes.label: D01: K=8 rung summed to nine, double-assigned a variate
nodes.rationale: Resolved to the one unique consistent cut.

nodes.label: D02: K_eff gate must not read the future
nodes.rationale: Gate computed on pre-first-origin span only; PR<5.0 trigger pre-registered.

nodes.label: D04: Instance-norm strips volatility level, confounding RQ1
nodes.rationale: PR measured on window-normalised features too, confound disclosed regardless of outcome.

nodes.label: D10: Claimed ffill / synthetic bars - CLOSED
nodes.rationale: Neither defect ever existed on the artifact; the register was stale, not the parquet.

nodes.label: D11: Missing Stage 1 script reference - CLOSED
nodes.rationale: Script is spot_klines_btc.py at repo root, not the referenced binance_spot_klines.py.

nodes.label: D12: signed_flow is a product of two other K=8 members
nodes.rationale: Kept, dependence disclosed; the measured PR settles the concern.

nodes.label: D13: F2 per-bar vs trailing-averaged was unspecified
nodes.rationale: Resolved: per-bar, no rolling window, for every F2 estimator.

nodes.label: D14: taker_buy_ratio denominator; H==L division by zero
nodes.rationale: Base-denominated ratio; zero-volume and H==L bars become segment breaks.

nodes.label: D22: No rung tested genuinely nonlinear features
nodes.rationale: Optional K=16 fifth rung proposed as resolution - ultimately not run.

nodes.label: D23: tau on D(b) is arithmetically unreachable - guaranteed null
nodes.rationale: D(i,b) rescaled to proportional skill loss on the skill scale, not RelMSE.

nodes.label: D25: ~17,400 wrongly used the 24-month count, not 21-month
nodes.rationale: Corrected to 13,558-15,217 windows, 70.12 MB, on the 21-month training sub-block.

nodes.label: D33: Section 4.1 paths point at empty data/raw/, boundary-bar defect
nodes.rationale: Paths corrected, out-of-window boundary bar dropped; closes D10 and D11.

nodes.label: D37: Linear-span exclusion argument was not a theorem
nodes.rationale: Demoted to a parsimony argument; K-as-RQ1's-independent-variable carries the exclusions.

nodes.label: D43: Leakage surface declared closed on a two-path enumeration
nodes.rationale: Re-enumerated as a boundary x channel grid, one Section 11 checklist item per non-empty cell.

nodes.label: D44: K_eff span undeclared for the RQ1 regressor; PR blind to cross-lag
nodes.rationale: Per-origin training-only span plus at least one lookback-aware measure reported alongside.

nodes.label: D45: Window loss reported globally hides per-block 50% loss
nodes.rationale: Per-origin/per-block accounting with exact-equality assertion against the origin window budget.

nodes.label: D48: Four outcome-determining choices left open after results
nodes.rationale: Sweep origins, regimes, slippage band, and gate action all fixed in advance rather than post hoc.

nodes.label: D49: Flat 8-to-12 rung had the fewest seeds, no equivalence test
nodes.rationale: Resolved with 5 seeds at every rung plus a pre-registered TOST equivalence margin.

nodes.label: D51a: Segment window closed form is not an identity
nodes.rationale: A negative per-segment charge was absorbed silently; count windows segment-wise instead.

nodes.label: D51b: Test blocks miscounted with training semantics, phantom loss
nodes.rationale: Test blocks correctly hold 720 forecast origins, not 601; a 16.5% phantom loss on a clean block.

nodes.label: D51c: H==L count never measured, assumed additive to zero-volume
nodes.rationale: Measured 3, and they are the same 3 bars as the zero-volume bars, not 9 total.

nodes.label: D52a: Rogers-Satchell falsely claimed strictly positive
nodes.rationale: Vanishes on 33 shadowless marubozu bars; resolved with log(RS+1e-9), kappa=1e-9 fixed.

nodes.label: D52c: Window budget measured on raw frame, not feature frame
nodes.rationale: Assert against the feature-frame numbers, 13,545-15,217, one fewer window per segment.

nodes.label: D53a: Stable rank of the K x 96 window block was a units artefact
nodes.rationale: Fixed by standardising each channel within its window before computing stable rank.

nodes.label: D53b: PR of the K.L x K.L covariance spectrum not monotone in K
nodes.rationale: Fixed by using the correlation spectrum, reported as a fraction of its K.L ceiling.

nodes.label: D60a: Stage 5 failed and the document did not say so for nine days
nodes.rationale: Title repositioned; K=16 recorded as not run because run-condition clause 1 failed.

nodes.label: D60b: RQ1/RQ2/RQ3 all had measured answers, none was in the document
nodes.rationale: Measured-answers table added to Section 3; the R2_oos<=0 guard turned out to be the only case, excluding all 15 origins.

nodes.label: D60h: Three unscoped numbers, including RS support pre/post kappa
nodes.rationale: RS support scoped: post-kappa min -20.723, pre-kappa figures were -23.5/-17.57.

nodes.label: spot_klines_btc.py - Stage 1 Ingest Script
nodes.rationale: pandas-exempt; paginates, coerces, de-duplicates, clips to window, counts gaps; clip_to_window() has a --self-test regression test.
